explanation: Single body falling under gravity g=30 with dt=1/30 and no walls/controller gains net energy in one step: y 11->8.8986 (drop 2.10m, potential loss ~63J) while speed 60->66 (kinetic gain ~378J), net +~315J. Allowed bound is 2348J but energy is 2444.9J. Likely cause: semi-implicit Euler with velocity-first updates adds g*dt to velocity then moves by new velocity, systematically over-adding kinetic energy when falling fast with large step/substep ratio, exceeding the 10%+5J tolerance.
